records.description: 20th century The reproduction European rapier swords, comprising a cup-hilt and loop-hilt rapier, housed in a gilt shadowbox wall frame with floral patterned border. Height: 140.5cm Width: 57cm Depth: 17cm

records.title: A JAPANESE BLUE AND WHITE ARITA 'SOMETSUKE' CHARGER ON STAND
records.description: Late Meiji period, 19th century With a scalloped rim, hand painted to the interior in the Chinese taste with underglaze blue composition featuring a songbird perched on a sweeping prunus branch above large peony blossoms, surrounded by a border of alternating minimalist coastal landscape and trailing white flora, the exterior with stylised sprigs, on an easel wooden Stand. Diameter:42cm

records.title: A JAPANESE BLUE AND WHITE ARITA 'SOMETSUKE' CHARGER ON STAND
records.description: Late Meiji period, late 19th century The large charger with a scalloped rim, hand painted to the interior in Japanese millefleur with a central medallion of overlapping kiku (chrysanthemum) blossoms, with a similar border to the cavetto, the outer rim with a geometric and floral diaper border, the exterior with a continuous cobalt blue border of stylised foliage, on an easel wooden Stand. Diameter: 47cm

records.title: A PAIR OF WAISTLESS HONGMU CORNER-LEG STOOLS
records.description: Qing Dynasty, 18th century Each with a rattan matted seat set within a square frame with thumb-grooved edges and raised on rounded section legs joined by humpback stretchers framing a stylised ruyi; with Sotheby's Australia labels. Height: 48cm Length: 42cm Width: 42cm

records.title: A CHINESE EXPORT BLACK LACQUERED SIDE CABINET
records.description: Mid to late 20th century With a double door upper compartment opening to a shelved interior above two small drawers and resting on short bracket feet, the front and sides decorated in relief with gilded songbirds perched on blossoming floral branches and framed by painted gilt diaper borders. Height: 92cm Length: 61cm Width: 30cm

records.title: A THAI PARCEL GILT BRONZE FIGURE OF AN ASPARA
records.description: early 20th century The lost wax casting of an Aspara standing in a graceful posture and holding a lotus flower in her right hand, in traditional ceremonial dress with tiered crown, necklace, armlets and flame patterned sarong, and raised upon a stepped square bronze pedestal base. Height: 59cm Width: 14cm

records.title: A GROUP OF ORIENTAL ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a Japanese satsuma export baluster vase with a flared rim hand decorated with a golden pheasant and floral sprays upon an ivory-tone crackle glaze, marked underside, a Japanese ceramic full sake bottle and cup set, a Japanese bronze mirror, one side relief cast with auspicious inscriptions and a crane over pine trees, a vintage Chinese brass-mounted soapstone trinket box of square form with a dragon medallion to the detachable cover, together with a Russian Zhostovo-style navette lacquer box painted with flower bouquets and signed Underside. Height: 33cm Width: 18cm (vase)

records.title: A CHINESE JADE FIGURE
records.description: Circa: 1950 The lady figure holding up two bunches of Grapes. Height: 19cm Width: 9cm (excluding 3.5cm stand)

records.title: THREE CHINESE AND JAPANESE EXPORT PORCELAIN PLATES
records.description: Comprising a graduated pair of Republic period octagonal famille rose plates decorated with stylised phoenixes soaring amidst floral sprays, butterflies and pomegranates framed by patterned flower heads border in iron red and gilt, each with a painted shou mark to the underside, together with a Japanese probably Arita dodecagonal plate with transfer blue and white decoration in imitation of Chinese Kangxi porcelain, with four-character apocryphal Kangxi mark to the underside. Diameter: 24cm (largest plate)

records.title: A CHINESE CARVED STONE MOUNTAIN ON STAND
records.description: 20th century The Tianhuang-type probably Shoushan stone of irregular upright boulder form, depicting a traditional mountainous landscape scene with pavilions, rocky outcrops, pine branches, bridge and waterfall cascade, the reverse incised with inscriptions; raised upon a stained timber stand, in fitted case. Height: 19cm Width: 15cm (base 6cm)

records.title: A GROUP OF JAPANESE CERAMIC ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a large circa 1980s Japanese Kozan-Gama porcelain fruit bowl decorated to the interior and exterior with a radiating design merging traditional Japanese gold brocade with Persian shamsa and arabesques, with printed mark underside, together with a nesting set of 3 Hayashi Kyuro Arita ware Imari scalloped bowls, the undersides with pomegranate crest, square seal mark and signed in blue script, and a c1930s Satsuma export moriage ewer decorated with a traditional Samurai Design. Height: 34.5cm Width: 17cm (jug)

records.title: A THREE-PIECE GROUP OF ASIAN CARVED WOODEN ELEPHANTS
records.description: Possibly Thailand or Ceylon, mid-20th century Comprising an adult elephant and two calves, each realistically carved in walking postures from dense tropical hardwood, with highly detailed wrinkled hide texture, the pad of one of the adult front legs with incised regional artisan mark, possibly in Sinhala or Thai. Height: 18cm Width: 24cm (largest)

records.title: TWO MONOCHROME CRACKLE-GLAZED CERAMIC VESSELS
records.description: 20th century The Song-style stoneware vessels covered with a brownish olive-green crackle glaze, comprising a bottle vase with a globular body, four small lug handles at the shoulder and concentric lines to the shoulder and flared neck, together with a jarlet of ovoid form, the undersides unglazed with spur marks. Height: 21.5cm Width: 15cm (larger)

records.title: A CHINESE CARVED MAMOTH IVORY FIGURE OF LI BAI
records.description: Qing Dynasty, 19th century The figure of a seated, robed and bearded Li Bai with well carved facial features, lightly inked, the underside with incised Ming Chenghua mark. Height: 15cm Width: 10cm

records.title: A GROUP OF ORIENTAL ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a small Satsuma baluster vase decorated with gilt-detailed bamboo stalks, with studio mark underside, a circa 1960s Japanese export earthenware bottle vase decorated in moriage enamel with a central geisha panel surrounded by dense scrollwork to the ovoid body, and a Chinese amber-style composite toggle of the three-legged money toad Jin Chan. Height: 25cm Width: 12cm

records.title: A GROUP OF ORIENTAL ITEMS
records.description: Comporising a Chinese c1960s cloisonne covered jar decorated with an overall pattern of scrolling floral blossoms in brown and olive tones, with a classic band of ruyi clouds to the rim, the domed cover with brass finial, together with a late 20th Chinese ceramic Nemuri-neko cat figurine, stamped underside, and an unframed oil painting of a tiger on canvas, signed lower lLeft Height: 12cm Width: 27cm (sleeping cat)

records.title: A CHINESE MOULDED 'SHUFU' BOWL
records.description: The Yuan-style shallow bowl with gently flaring sides rising from a small unglazed foot ring, the interior moulded in low relief with a chrysanthemum medallion surrounded by three soaring cranes amidst clouds and the characters shu and fu, covered in a pale milky-white glaze. Height: 6cm Width: 19.5cm

records.title: A PAIR OF CLOISONNE VASES AND A CINNABAR STYLE VASE
records.description: 20th century The pair of Chinese cloisonne baluster vases on wooden stands, each decorated with a vase of plum blossom and auspicious objects upon a beige ground of trefoil wirework, together with a 'black on red' cinnabar style vase featuring two panels of 5-clawed dragons swirling through a diaper patterned fiery sky. Height: 18cm Width: 9cm (cloisonne) Stand - 3cm

records.title: A WOOD OKIMONO OF A MONKEY
records.description: Probably Taisho period, 20th century The seated monkey realistically modelled scratching his head with one hand, the eyes inlaid in glass with dark pupils, unsigned. Height: 7cm Width: 5cm

records.title: A SPINACH JADE BOWL AND OTHER CARVED HARDSTONE ITEMS
records.description: mid-20th century The bowl carved with rounded sides rising to an everted rim, raised on a slightly splayed cylindrical foot, the polished stone of moss green tone mottled with creamy and darker streaks and inclusions, on a carved wooden stand, together with a tang-style carved serpentine horse on fitted stand, and a Chinese yellow-green serpentine decorative teapot and cover (a/f) on stand. Height: 28cm Width: 31cm (horse)

records.title: A KUTANI 'MILLE-FLEUR' PORCELAIN TEA SERVICE FOR FIVE
records.description: Showa period, 20th century Comprising a teapot, 5 teacups and saucers, a covered sugar bowl and a covered milk jug, all richly decorated in the iconic 'Hanazume' pattern with a thousand flowers accented with gilt detailing, each piece with Kutani studio mark to the underside. Height: 13cm Width: 20cm (teapot)

records.title: A CHINESE PLIQUE-A-JOUR CLOISONNE ENAMEL VASE
records.description: Late Republic period, 20th century The baluster vase decorated with all-over brass fish-scale wirework interspersed with polychrome transparent enamel butterflies, fish and peony sprays in green, maroon, yellow and blue tones. Height: 7cm Width: 9cm9

records.title: A CELADON 'BAMBOO-NECK' VASE, XIANWENPING
records.description: The Southern Song style vase with a compressed, spreading body carved with a series of shallow horizontal grooves, and the tall tapering neck encircled by two bow-string bands in imitation of bamboo below the wide, galleried mouth with incurved rim, and covered overall with a celadon tea-dust glaze ending just short of the unglazed foot rim. Height: 16cm Width: 10cm

records.title: A BLUE AND WHITE STEM-CUP AND A DRAGON VASE
records.description: Comprising a thinly potted stem-cup with deep rounded sides rising to a flaring rim, supported on a slightly spreading foot, painted to the exterior with a repeat pattern of figures, the underside with underglaze blue Chenghua mark, together with a dragon vase with dragon twin handles in the Ming manner. Height: 14.5cm Width: 7cm

records.title: A MIXED GROUP OF ORIENTAL ITEMS
records.description: Comprising an elongated baluster small eggshell porcelain vase decorated in famille rose with a bird on branches and inscriptions, two blue and white porcelain and inside painted snuff bottles, a carnelian pierced pendant plaque with a stylised phoenix, a soapstone oval seal surmounted with a rabbit and an enamelled mirror handle. Height: 16cm Width: 5cm

records.title: AN ASSORTED GROUP OF CHINESE SNUFF BOTTLES
records.description: The 6 snuff bottles with stoppers in brass and domed stone or glass, comprising one of flattened circular flask form in reconstituted turquoise, an octagonal one on faceted amber glass with golden inclusions, a cased glass snuff bottle in the form of a frog or taod, and others in hardstone and composite materials. Height: 9cm Width: 4.5cm (white bottle)

records.title: AN ASSORTED GROUP OF CHINESE SNUFF BOTTLES
records.description: The 9 snuff bottles with porcelain, stone, composite and brass stoppers, comprising two blue and white porcelain - one decorated with lotus flowers and foliage, two famille rose porcelain with figural scenes - one erotic, two milk glass snuff bottles - one enamelled with bird on branches, one inside painted glass with monkeys at play, one in white metal embossed with interior figural scenes, and one composite of elongated bottle form with a painted chilong in high relief and gilt accents. Height: 11.5cm Width: 4.5cm (dragon detail)

records.title: TWO SIGNED IVORY NETSUKES
records.description: late Meiji period, early 20th century Comprising one of two rats with a bag, possibly Daikoku's bag of riches, one inside, the other clambering on top, signed to the underside, together with a netsuke of a duck holding a fish in its beak, signed Underside. Height: 3cm Width: 5cm (duck)

records.title: A CHINESE BLUE AND WHITE 'DOUBLE HAPPINESS' JAR AND COVER
records.description: The elongated ovoid export jar decorated with double happiness symbols and freely executed scrolling sweet pea motifs throughout between a lappet band to the base and a foliage border to the rim with ruyi accents, the flush cover with plantain leaves and knop finial. Height: 31cm Width: 19cm

records.title: A PAIR OF KANGXI STYLE BLUE AND WHITE SMALL BOWLS
records.description: Late Qing, late 19th century The charming pair of small bowls or saucers with scalloped rims, each decorated with a central roundel of scholarly furniture supporting vases of peony and prunus branches, and surrounded by alternating landscape and precious object vignettes, the exterior and underside with floral sprigs and four-character Kangxi marks within double circles. Height: 3cm Width: 12.5cm

records.title: A JAPANESE IVORY KAGAMIBUTA NETSUKE
records.description: Late Edo to early Meiji period, 19th century The shibuichi disc set inside a finely reeded and polished ivory bowl, worked in relief and accented in gold, depicting the phantom ghost of the Taira clan emerging from rolling waves and receiving the royal sword at the battle of Dannoura (April 25, 1185), a story reenacted in the Noh play Funa Benkei, with multi-strand metallic pocket chain. Height: 15cm Width: 6cm

records.title: AN ANTIQUE THAI TERRACOTTA CROWNED BUDDHA HEAD ON STAND
records.description: Ayutthaya period, 16-17th century The head fragment with multi-pointed regal crown and prominent ear-flange ornaments, mounted on a burr walnut display stand. Provenance: From the collection of Veronica and Dr Christopher Hazzard. Height: 15cm Width: 7cm

records.title: A CHINESE PORCELAIN 'HUA MULAN' VASE
records.description: Circa 1970 In the Republic style, the Jingdezhen vase of elongated ovoid form rising to a flared neck, the body meticulously hand painted in grey and iron red with gilt accents with a narrative scene of the legendary heroine Mulan and three attendants, depicted seated in battle armour and civilian courtly robes, with a poetic inscription to the reverse and Autumn of Dingmao cyclical date (1927) flanked by red seal marks, the neck and foot with fine hand-painted lotus blossoms, foliage and tendrils with geometric borders, the underside with Jingdezhen seal Mark. Height: 28cm Width: 10cm

records.title: A GILT-BRONZE AND CLOISONNE ENAMEL 'TAOTIE' TRIPOD CENSER
records.description: Late Qing, late 19th century Of compressed globular form, the upper shoulder decorated with a vibrant cloisonne enamel band of archaistic taotie masks amidst stylised ruyi clouds, the lower body, rim and cover with all-over honeycomb diaper pattern, all raised upon tripod scrolling legs emanating from mythical beast masks, with scrolled loop handles, the pierced cover surmounted by a seated Buddhist lion Finial. Height: 21cm Width: 19cm

records.title: A CHINESE CARVED FLUORITE COVERED URN
records.description: Late Qing, circa 1900 The slightly tapering urn and cover carved in relief with birds on blossoming plum branches, the translucent stone of a grass-green tone with icy white inclusions and russet Inclusions. Height: 21cm Width: 12cm

records.title: THREE CARVED SOAPSTONE DESK ORNAMENTS
records.description: Republic period, 20th century The mottled soapstone carvings, comprising a figural vase or brush wash in reddish stone with black inclusions, carved in openwork with an elder holding a peach by a single floral engraved vase, another in grey stone with two vases and a two-tone floral spray on stand. Height: 13cm Width: 17cm

records.title: THREE CARVED SOAPSTONE DESK ORNAMENTS
records.description: Republic period, 20th century The mottled soapstone carvings, comprising a figural double-vase or brush wash carved in openwork with animals and floral sprays on a rockwork base, another with a single vase and ashtray in pale celadon stone and a smaller one in reddish to dark brown stone depicting a monkey and a bird by a single vase. Height: 10.5cm Width: 23cm

records.title: A CHINESE CARVED IVORY PUZZLE BALL ON STAND AND A FIGURINE
records.description: early and mid-20th century Comprising a five-layer puzzle ball with writhing dragon decoration to outer orb, upon a low stand with a stiff leaf border, together with a figure of a fisherman holding his fishing net mounted on a wooden base. Height: 14.5cm Width: 6cm (including stand) Fisherman

records.title: A GROUP OF IVORY ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a Japanese carved ivory okimono of a fisherman with his bamboo fishing rod and catch of the day, a Cantonese export needle book with two carved ivory shaped panels carved in low relief with Chinese figures in garden setting under pine trees, four small ivory elephant pendants and a bag of small ivory pieces and gold plated miniature Buckles. Height: 29cm Width: 5cm

records.title: A CHINESE BRASS MOUNTED ROSEWOOD JEWELLERY CABINET
records.description: mid-20th century The brass bound small cabinet featuring two doors opening to a pair of small drawers, above another drawer, the doors and sides inset with engraved brass and plaques of dragons and auspicious characters and symbols, reinforced corners and a stylised bat top Handle. Height: 23cm Length: 17cm Width: 12cm

records.title: A GROUP OF ORIENTAL ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a Japanese carved ivory okimono of a geisha in traditional dress and holding a flower pot, unmarked, a/f with repair to the head, a cased set of two hardstone miniature seals with lion finials, uncut, together with a carved tagua nut thimble holder in the form of an Acorn. Height: 9cm Width: 3cm (oriental lady)

records.title: A CASED JAPANESE GEISHA WIG (KATSURA) AND A BOX OF PHOTOGRAPHS
records.description: Showa period, mid to later 20th century The geisha wig in Tsubushi Shimada style with jet-black natural hair with sweeping side wings and topknot loop (mage) wrapped in a paper collar, upon a metallic base with inscriptions and housed in a green hardcase, together with a group of vintage and c1920s Japanese photographs including a formal gelatin silver studio portrait of a bride and groom in traditional wedding attire. Height: 33cm Width: 29cm (wig)

records.title: A JAPANESE GINGER JAR AND AN ENGLISH CHINOISERIE BOWL
records.description: Comprising an early Japanese Imari export ginger jar, of traditional form0 with a blue-wash ground, underglaze decorated with deep blue chrysanthemums and scrolling foliage, the shoulder with a latticed border and floral reserves in iron red and green, the cover (a/f with crack) with chrysanthemum spray; together with a large c1910 Mailing Cetem-ware ceramic bowl, transfer-decorated to the interior and with painted highlights, depicting four cranes amidst clouds upon a black ground and surrounded by a patterned border, stamped Underside. Height: 7.5cm Width: 34cm (bowl)

records.title: A JAPANESE IMARI PORCELAIN OVAL PEACOCK PLATTER
records.description: Late Meiji period, 19th century The heavy gauge oval platter with a wavy, scalloped rim, decorated with an underglaze blue peacock in landscape, with an iron-red overglaze patterned border, the exterior with floral sprigs, with repair to the Rim. Height: 30cm Width: 38cm

records.title: A PAIR OF EDWARD VII STERLING SILVER MUSTARD POTS
records.description: 1907 London, with maker's marks for William Hutton & Sons Ltd Each of straight-sided oval form with flat hinged lids and S-scroll handles with thumbpiece, the sides with beaded borders, vertical pierce-work and neoclassical ribbon-and-swag garlands, complete with blue glass liners and earlier fiddle pattern mustard spoons (1863 London, Henry Holland). Silver Weight: 165gr Height: 5cm Width: 8.5cm

records.title: A RARE PAIR OF GEORGE I BRITANNIA SILVER DINNER PLATES
records.description: 1724 London, with maker's marks for Edward Cornock The fine pair of heavy gauge circular plates, each with a cast rope-work gadrooned rim and flat-chased border of husks integrating family crests celebrating a prominent early 18th century British aristocratic alliance, the main crests of a dexter hand holding a feather quill, and of a lion statant holding a trefoil, each marked underside and engraved with scratch weights in troy ounces and pennyweights, respectively 22:0 and 20:8. Weight: 1231gr Diameter 23.5cm

records.title: A GEORGE V STERLING SILVER 3-PIECE TEA SERVICE
records.description: 1913 Sheffield, with maker's marks for Henry Williamson The elegant tea set comprising teapot, open sugar bowl and creamer, of oval tapering lobed and panelled design, each with pierced foliate gallery and raised upon stylised scroll feet with bifurcated knuckle brackets, the teapot with swan-neck spout and sweeping wooden handle; each marked under the rim. Weight: 1395gr Height: 17cm Width: 27cm (largest pot)

records.title: A GROUP OF STERLING AND .800 SILVER ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a sauce boat (1938 Sheffield, Viner's Ltd) of plain design with a scalloped rim, marked under the rim, a pair of small, pierced baskets (1911 Birmingham, Levi & Salaman) with swing handles, cast floral and scroll rims and foliate pierced sides, each marked to the interior and stamped with registration number underside, together with a Hanau .800 silver circular pill box, plain with detachable domed cover with stylized monogram. Weight: 264 Height: 7cm Width: 15cm (sauce boat)

records.title: A GEORGE III STERLING SILVER SALVER
records.description: 1770 London, with maker's mark for John Carter II (probably) Of shaped, circular form with shell and scroll border and raised on tripod pad feet, marked to the underside (probably John Carter II, but a similar mark registered by John Cox in Aug. 1763). Weight: 270g Height: 3cm Width: 18cm

records.title: A SET OF GEORGE II STERLING SILVER CASTERS BY SAMUEL WOOD
records.description: 1734 London, with maker's marks for Samuel Wood The rare matching set of three early George II casters by the specialist maker of the period engraved with the original crest of their owner, comprising one larger and two smaller, all of baluster form on stepped circular bases, the removable covers pierced with alternate panels of lattice and fleur-de-lys surmounted with baluster finials, each marked to the underside and cover with Samuel Wood's first mark; the heraldic crests of an eagle rising from a rocky mount, holding an olive branch in its beak, possibly for the Smith Family (London and Essex branches). Weight: 367g Height: 15.5cm Width: 7cm (largest)

records.title: A GEORGE V STERLING SILVER TWO-HANDLED TRAY
records.description: 1913 Birmingham, with maker's mark for Wilmot manufacturing Co The elegant tray of shaped oval form with piecrust cast rim and twin-handles to a plain surface, marked to the interior. Weight: 1390gr Height: 30cm Width: 53cm

records.title: A GROUP OF ANTIQUE STERLING AND .800 SILVER SPOONS
records.description: Comprising a pair of continental .800 silver fiddle pattern dinner spoons (1872-1922 period, Vienna Dianakopf mark) each marked under the terminal, a late 18th century Hanoverian pattern crested spoon (marks illegible), a teaspoon (1810 London, Thomas Wallis II & Jonathan Hayne) and a mustard spoon (1796 London, Solomon Hougham). Weight: 227g Height: 22cm Width: 4.5cm (largest)

records.title: A GEORGE II STERLING SILVER SALVER
records.description: 1738 London, with maker's mark for Denis Langton Shaped circular with shell moulded scalloped border and raised upon tripod volute supports, marked and further engraved to the underside with Roman Block wedding initials as a betrothal triangle I above I(star)A. Weight: 225gr Height: 3cm Width: 15cm

records.title: A MIXED GROUP OF SILVER & SILVER-PLATED SOUVENIR & OTHER SPOONS
records.description: Comprising an Austrian .800 silver 'Tirol' souvenir spoon, a Swiss 800 silver 'Zurich' spoon by Tezler, a pair of coffee spoons with paua shell terminals stamped Stg. Sil and 1966 Sheffield SCS, an 800 silver spoon with an exotic dance terminal, an English berry coffee spoon with rubbed marks and a dessert spoon (1828 London, William Eaton), together with a silver-plated coffee spoon with Empire State Building terminal by Fort Inc and a set of 3 Italian gilt brass Renaissance style figural spoons with twisted stems. Silver Weight: 102gr. Height: 17.5cm Width: 4cm

records.title: A VICTORIAN STERLING SILVER PEDESTAL TEAPOT
records.description: 1850 London, with maker's mark for William Hunter The compressed body repousse and chased with sweeping acanthus leaves and floral scrolls, the hinged cover with applied overlapping acanthus leaves and flower head finial, the scroll handle with acanthus thumb spur and ivory insulators, upon a circular pedestal foot; clearly marked to the underside. Weight: 739g Height: 19cm Width: 26cm

records.title: A PAIR OF GEORGE V STERLING SILVER SALAD SERVERS
records.description: 1917 Sheffield, with maker's marks for Mappin & Webb Ltd The pair of salad servers with beautiful tapering handles decorated in openwork with husk borders and foliate scrolls to Neo-gothic pointed terminals, each marked under the handle. Weight: 156gr Height: 22cm Width: 5.5cm

records.title: A WILLIAM & MARY STERLING SILVER LACEBACK TREFID SPOON
records.description: 1689 London, with maker's mark for Thomas Allen Dating from the first year of the reign of William III and Mary II, the spoon with reeded rattail, trefid terminal with 'ears' and a laceback design to the reverse of the bowl and front of the terminal, the reverse terminal engraved with an original dot-pricked betrothal triangle S over T and M, where 'T' and 'M' represent the first names and 'S' the surname of the newlyweds; marked to the back of the stem. Weight: 58gr Height: 20cm Width: 4.5cm

records.title: A GEORGE III STERLING SILVER SPOON
records.description: 1774 London, with maker's mark for Thomas Dealtry The Old English pattern (probably christening) spoon with the terminal engraved 'F.G BORN Nov 29 1771' in Roman Block and script; marked to the back of the stem. Weight: 60gr Height: 21cm Width: 4cm

records.title: A CASED GEORGE VI STERLING SILVER CONDIMENT SET
records.description: 1948-50 Sheffield, with maker's mark for Viner's Ltd (Emile Viner) The complete 6-piece condiment set comprising two salt and pepper shakers, one lidded mustard pot with liner and original mustard spoon, a sugar caster and a sauce jug, each on square pedestal bases and marked under the rim, in their original velvet lined fitted case. Weight: 350g Height: 15cm Width: 5cm (shaker)

records.title: A JAPANESE .925 SILVER ASHTRAY CASE
records.description: Yamazaki Shoten, circa 1930s The rectangular case decorated to the slightly domed detachable cover with plum and bamboo sprays, opening to a wood-lined interior with removable ashtray, with 'silver' and Swithin 5-point star marks for Yamazaki. Total Weight: 155g Height: 4cm Length: 10.5cm Width: 8cm

records.title: A WILLIAM IV STERLING SILVER MOUNTED SUGAR CASTER AND THREE COFFEE SPOONS
records.description: 1834 Sheffield, with maker's mark for Waterhouse, Hodson & Co The sugar caster in the Gothic Revival style with vertical cut glass flutes mimicking pointed lancet windows, the detachable cover with scrolls border and flame finial, marked to the rim, together with a set of 3 Australian sterling silver demitasse coffee spoons with Corinthian capital terminals (Melbourne, Rodd). Silver Weight: 43gr Height: 13cm Width: 5cm

records.title: AN INDIAN .900 SILVER ROUND BETEL BOX
records.description: circa 1900 The Indian paan dan of circular domed form with a hinged cover and traditional clasp, repousse decorated with two continuous bands of elephants parading through scrolling foliage and a raised central flowerhead, stamped 900 and X-Ray tested .900 silver. Weight: 319g Height: 7cm Width: 13cm

records.title: A GROUP OF BURMESE AND OTHER .925 AND .800 SILVER ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a Burmese .950 silver salt cellar chased with scrolls on tripod ball feet (X-Ray tested 950), a c1900 Burmese tripod betel box repousse and chased with figure from the Jakata tales, the cover with Burmese guardian lion-dragon (chinthe) finial (X-Ray tested .800), a Yogya .800 silver small serving dish (800 maker ZR), a small silver small dish with a husk border to the rim stamped 900, a late 19th century Burmese heart shaped box (X-Ray tested .900), a fine colonial Indian pepper shaker (tested .900 silver), and a small Indian serving bowl with scrolls border (Tested .850 Silver). Weight: 406g Height: 9.5cm Width: 9cm (largest round lidded box)

records.title: AN EGYPTIAN .900 SILVER TRIPOD CANDY DISH
records.description: The tripod bowl with a repousse and pierced floral border surrounding a central radiating sun, marked to the scroll feet. Weight: 188g Height: 4cm Width: 19cm

records.title: A BURMESE .950 SILVER INCENSE HOLDER
records.description: X-Ray tested .950 silver, early 20th century The apparently unmarked incense holder of double-walled ring form, repousse decorated with a continuous frieze of palmettes. Weight: 288g Height: 5cm Width: 21cm

records.title: AN ASSORTED GROUP OF FOUR .925 SILVER PILL BOXES AND VESTA CASE
records.description: Comprising an Edwardian plain hinged top vesta case with a bail, marked to the inner rim (1907 Chester, William Neale & Sons), a round pill box with domed cover and gilt interior (1918 Birmingham, Samuel M Levi), a twist lock safety pill box stamped 925 and with 1974 London silver import and sponsor marks, together with a plain square pill box with detachable cover, stamped 925 with unknown TP and dog mark. Weight: 65g Height: 4cm Width: 3cm (vesta)

records.title: A CASED SET OF ELIZABETH II STERLING SILVER COFFEE SPOONS
records.description: 1955 Birmingham, with maker's mark for Angora Silver Plate Co Ltd The set of spoons with tapering handles and pointed terminals, each marked under the handle, in their black velvet lined fitted case. Weight: 65g Height: 11.5cm Width: 2.5cm

records.title: A PAIR OF DANISH STERLING SILVER SALT CELLARS AND OTHER ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a boxed pair of Danish sterling silver and green guilloche enamel salt cellars with spoons (Copenhagen, Egon Lauridsen, mid-20th century), a cut glass ovoid perfume with guilloche blue enamel brass stopper, together with a vintage soviet Russian salt cellar, cloisonne decorated on metal with stylised berries and foliage (Mstera factory, 1960s), with glass liner. records.title: THREE BOXED SETS OF FRENCH CRYSTAL GLASSES
records.description: Artissant de Lorraine Circa: 1950 The 24% crystal flutes with hand cut decoration comprising six each of champagne, red wine and white wine glasses Height: 21cm Width: 7cm (champagne flute)

records.title: AN ITALIAN 5-PIECE DRINKS SET ON TRAY
records.description: Comprising a mid-century glass decanter and stopper with 4 matching stem glasses in blue toned glass with gilded decoration, upon an oval tray with pierced brass gallery and floral inlaid top. Height: 31cm Width: 51.5cm (tray)

records.title: A PAIR OF PRESSED LUSTRE GLASS CANDLE STICKS WITH HURRICANE GLASS SHADES
records.description: 20th century The pair in green glass with gilding and painted floral decoration. Height: 55cm Width: 15cm

records.title: AN ASSORTED GROUP OF WATERFORD CRYSTAL ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a set of four Waterford Marquis line champagne flutes, a Waterford 'Sheridan' pattern vase of flared form, a pair of Marquis line candle holders and a 'Lismore' decanter bottle with ball stopper, each with etched Waterford mark. Height: 23cn Width: 16cm (vase)

records.title: A WHITEFRIARS RUBY RED GLASS 'RIBBON TRAIL' VASE
records.description: The classic British vase of bucket form designed by Barnaby Powell for Whitefriars (1935), pattern no 9030 or 8886, in catalogues 1938-1966, with polished pontil mark underside, Unmarked. Height: 21cm Width: 18cm

records.title: A BOHEMIAN ENAMELLED URANIUM GLASS PITCHER
records.description: early to mid-20th century In light yellow-greenish glass, the baluster form ewer or pitcher decorated to the exterior with cream and yellow enamelled scrollwork and floral sprays, unmarked. Height: 28cm Width: 15cm

records.title: A SWAROVSKI 'POOH & PALS' MATTED LITHOGRAPH
records.description: Des. Dave Pacheco (Disney) for Swarovski, 2007 The special edition unframed lithograph depicting Winnie, Tigger, Eeyore and Piglet, signed d. Pacheco and dated 2007, the matte adorned with Swarovski crystals spelling out 'Pooh & Pals', with certificate of verification Verso. Height: 28cm Width: 36cm (ncluding frame)

records.title: AN ITALIAN TERRACOTTA FIGURE OF A YOUNG WOMAN BY LUIGI PAOLETTI
records.description: Mid-20th century The charming art pottery portrait of a young girl with thick and cascading hair, upon an integral base, incised 'Paoletti' to the reverse. Height: 19cm Width: 12cm

records.title: AN ART DECO TERRACOTTA FIGURE OF SEATED LADY BY REZL
records.description: Bohumil Rezl (Czech/French 1899-1963), circa 1930 Modelled as a pensive lady sitting on a stepped oval terrace base, the repeating folds of her dramatic multi-layered crinoline dress falling gracefully, with incised signature 'B. Rezl' to the reverse. Height: 37cm Width: 44cm

records.title: SCOTT REDFORD (B. 1962)
records.description: 'My Beautiful Polar Bear' Glazed Ceramic (orange) Signed, editioned 3/30 dated 2012 to the underside. Height: 27cm Width: 40cm

records.title: AN ELLIS 'THINKER' POTTERY FIGURINE
records.description: Mid-20th century The Australian pottery 'Thinker' in a rare lime green crackle glaze. Height: 21cm Width: 15cm

records.title: A MILES MASON CHINOISERIE 'BOY AT THE DOOR' PATTERN PART TEA SET
records.description: Attributed to Miles Mason, circa 1800 Comprising a teapot, a milk jug and a slop bowl, each painted in 'Boy at the door' pattern with a charming oriental scene of a boy standing looking out of the door at other figures conversing outside in a garden landscape, unmarked. Height: 17cm Width: 27cm (teapot)

records.title: TWO DRESDEN PORCELAIN MOUNTED WALL SHELVES
records.description: late 19th century The two ebonised open wall shelves with mirror backs and arched crests, flanked by spiral moulded, floral encrusted and painted porcelain support columns richly encrusted with trailing foliage and spring flowers, one with putti finials, the other with floral topiaries. Height: 21cm Length: 24cm Width: 12cm

records.title: A LARGE DRESDEN PORCELAIN PEDESTAL URN AND COVER BY CARL THIEME
records.description: late 19th century The fine potpourri urn of baluster form, finely painted with central courting scenes to the front and reverse, the handles modelled as nymphs holding garlands of flowers, the pierced cover of bombe domed form surmounted with a branch of roses in high relief, adorned with floral encrustations and marked with underglaze T over crossed swords mark (used before 1901) to the underside. Height: 73cm Width: 33cm

records.title: A MEISSEN THREE-LIGHT FIGURAL CANDELABRA
records.description: late 19th century Modelled as a rustic trunk encrusted with floral blossoms and foliage and supporting three scrolled floriate candle sconces, featuring a young boy playing the violin in 18th century dress, above a girl at the base gathering flowers, the underside with underglaze blue crossed swords and impressed with number 20. Height: 22.5cm Width: 20cm

records.title: AN ART DECO MAJOLICA PITCHER BY FRIE ONNAING
records.description: circa 1920s The pitcher of hexagonal form with moulded layered geometric forms in olive green, tan and teal colours with clusters of pink roses, with impressed marks underside. Height: 20cm Width: 17cm

records.title: A FRENCH ART DECO MAJOLICA PITCHER BY ONNAING
records.description: circa 1920s The square section pitcher with a bracket handle applied to one edge, a moulded sunburst and geometric frieze in maroon, amber, yellow and blue colours above a similarly patterned lower register in olive, impressed marks of Frie [Fa?encerie] Onnaing and 879 to the underside. Height: 19cm Width: 16cm

records.title: A ROYAL DUX PORCELAIN FIGURE OF LADY GODIVA ON HORSEBACK
records.description: Des. Jaroslav Jezek for Royal Dux, circa 1960 Modelled as naked young woman riding side saddle on a white horse, with impressed numerals 685 and pink bisque triangular tablet with impressed D mark (used 1951-), as found with repair to the right arm. Height: 34cm Width: 28cm

records.title: A GROUP OF SIX FAIENCE APOTHECARY JARS
records.description: early and mid-20th century The mixed group of mostly French painted apothecary jars and covers with inscriptions, comprising a tin glazed earthenware 'Arsenic' Moustiers jar painted with floral bouquets in typical ochre and blue-green tones, a Coimbra (Portugal) blue an white 'Tilia' jar, three St Clement jars and a smaller one in Delft d?cor by 'Geo Martel', each signed to the underside. Height: 31cm Width: 15cm (largest)

records.title: A PAIR OF MEISSEN PORCELAIN PLATES AND A BOWL
records.description: Mid-20th century The pair of Meissen B-form plates after a 19th century Leuteritz design, with scalloped rims, a dense stippled ground and heavily adorned in gilt relief with star, c-scroll and acanthus leaf borders, together with a deeply moulded scalloped bowl with radiating flutes and gilt detailed foliate reeds, each with underglaze blue crossed sword marks. Height: 5cm Width: 28cm (largest plate)

records.title: A FRAMED BERLIN KPM PORCELAIN PORTRAIT PLAQUE SIGNED JAMRATH
records.description: Johann Friedrich Jamrath (Berlin 1810-1891) The rectangular porcelain plaque finely hand-painted with a half-length portrait of a lady with a ringlet hairstyle, and dressed in Biedermeier fashion with a pelerine over a dark gown with voluminous sleeves accented with a gold pendant necklace, signed 'F. Jamrath' lower left and dated 1844, housed in a giltwood and composition gilt frame with a beaded border. Height: 19cm Width: 16cm (including frame)

records.title: A MIXED GROUP OF ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a c1930s Burleigh Ware 'The Runaway Marriage' relief-moulded ceramic jug, a pair of Australian Don Shiel aluminum alloy goblets, signed and dated 81, a modern 'Porcelain de Paris' square vide-poche decorated to the interior with a Maharaja riding a caparisoned elephant, stamped to the exterior, a Swarovski crystal 'Bunch of grapes' (011864) and a Wedgwood Vera Wang 'Treasures with love' trinket box with Art Deco style guilloche enamel lid and seashell clasp. Height: 21.5cm Width: 18cm (jug)

records.title: TWO LLADRO FIGURINES
records.description: Comprising a 'Golfer' figurine (Model 4284, Des. Vicente Martinez, 1972) featuring a male golfer dynamically posed mid-swing, together with a 'Feeding the Ducks' figurine (Model 1052, Des, Vicente Martinez, 1970), each with Lladro printed mark and other cyphers to the underside. Height: 29cm Width: 14cm (golfer)

records.title: THREE LLADRO AND NAO FIGURINES
records.description: Comprising a Lladro 'Cat and Mouse' figurine (Model 5236, Des. Juan Huerta, 1984), a Lladro 'Girl with Brush' (Model 1081, Des. Vicenter Martinez, 1969) featuring a seated young girl brushing her hair, a/f missing the vanity mirror in her left hand, together with a Nao 'Ballerina with ball' figurine (Model 1178, Des. Vicente Martinez, 1993), each with printed mark and other cyphers to the underside. Height: 21cm Width: 11cm (girl brushing hair)

records.title: THREE LLADRO FIGURINES
records.description: Comprising a 'Mayumi' Geisha figurine (Model 1449, Des. Salvador Debon, 1983) depicting a young Japanese woman in a draped lavender kimono tending to a small bonsai tree, a 'Flower Harvest' boy figurine (Model 1286, Des. Francisco Catala, 1971) and a 'Nature's Bounty' Dutch girl figurine (Model 1417, Des. Francisco Catala, 1982), each with Lladro printed mark and other cyphers to the underside. Height: 21cm Width: 11cm (flower girl)

records.title: A PAIR OF CARL THIEME DRESDEN PORCELAIN COVERED URNS
records.description: Carl Thieme, Potschappel, late 19th century The pair of pedestal urns of baluster form with twin handles and pierced covers, the exterior elaborately encrusted in high relief with floral blossoms of roses, forget-me-nots and foliage, the smooth porcelain reserves hand-painted with polychrome sprays of summer blossoms, each with underglaze blue mark to the underside. Height: 32cm Width: 15cm

records.title: A DELFT BLUE AND WHITE OCTAGONAL COVERED VASE
records.description: maker's mark of Boch Keramis, early to mid-20th century The baluster octagonal moulded vase decorated with a shaped panel of a lakeside windmill scene to one side and a floral sprig to the other, surrounded by floral patterns, the domed cover with lion finial, with painted KB monogram for Boch Keramis Fr?res and numbered 365 to the Underside. Height: 43cm Width: 18cm

records.title: A WEDGWOOD GREEN MAJOLICA CENTERPIECE BOWL AND A SERVING DISH
records.description: c1959-1960 Comprising an elongated boat form centerpiece bowl in grape leaf pattern with faux-branch twin-handles, together with a tripartite grape leaf serving dish, each with Wedgwood Etruria & Barlaston marks and impressed date codes. Height: 16cm Width: 32cm

records.title: A SET OF FIVE ROYAL DOULTON TEACUP TRIOS
records.description: Mid-20th century The set of shaped pink glazed teacups decorated with lattice and floral border and matching saucers, each stamped to the underside and inscribed with numbers 3390 and H 4185. Diameter: 17.5cm (dessert plate)

records.title: A MARTIN BOYD POTTERY PORTRAIT WALL PLATE
records.description: Mid-20th century Hand painted with a portrait of an aboriginal man, incised 'Martin Boyd, Australia' to the reverse. Diameter: 18cm

records.title: GUY MARTIN A'BECKETT BOYD (Australia 1923-1988)
records.description: A PAIR of PLATES The glazed earthenware plates, handpainted with scenes of cleaning ladies with brooms. Incised signature verso. Diameter:15.5cm

records.title: THREE ROYAL COPENHAGEN AND BING & GRONDAHL FIGURINES
records.description: Comprising a Bing & Grondahl 'Boy Holding a Puppy / Ole' group (Des. Ingeborg Plockross Irminger, B&G model no. 1747), a 'Girl with Snowball' (Des. Sterett-Gittings Kelsey, Royal Copenhagen no. 5656), and a 'The Swimmer' monthly figurine (Des. Hans Henrik Hansen, Royal Copenhagen no. 4529), each with backstamp to the Underside. Height: 16cm Width: 7cm (boy with dog)

records.title: A GROUP OF CERAMIC FIGURINES AND OTHER ITEMS
records.description: Comprising a Royal Crown Derby 'Robin' paperweight (Des. Robert Jefferson, 1981), a Coalport 'My Teddy' figurine, a Royal Doulton 'Babie' figurine (Hn. 1679), two c1980s Coalport bone china Paddington bear 'Tobogganing' and 'Having a nap' figurines and an Australiana Bunnykins Bowl. Height: 19cm Width: 9cm (girl holding teddy)

records.title: A ROYAL DOULTON BONE CHINA COFFEE SERVICE
records.description: circa 1930s The demitasse coffee service comprising a coffee pot, 6 coffee cups, 6 saucers, sugar bowl and creamer, of octagonal shape decorated with alternating vertical panels of maroon-red glaze and richly gilded panels filled with dense scrolling blossoms, most stamped and with pattern and shape number to the underside. Height: 22.5cm Width: 13.5cm (coffee pot)

records.title: A FRENCH .950 SILVER MOUNTED PAUL MILET FOR SEVRES COBALT BLUE VASE
records.description: Antoine Th?odore Eysen, Paris (mount), Paul Milet for Sevres (vase), c1890s The fine ovoid vase with a high-gloss, deep cobalt blue glaze, the rim with a finely cast and chased French 1st standard silver mount featuring three masks of Bacchus suspending garlands of fruiting grapevine, the mount marked twice with Minerva 1, maker's mark (A scales E), the vase with late 19th century underglaze Sevres mark (pre-dating the Milet workshop for Sevres dotted Marks). Height: 15cm Width: 8cm

records.title: A FIRST PERIOD BELLEEK 'GRASS' PATTERN TEAPOT AND SUGAR BOWL
records.description: First black mark, period 1863-1890 The tea kettle and cover, finely moulded and highlighted in coloured enamels, with arched handle and bird-head spout, with matching sugar bowl and cover, both with printed first black mark. Height: 16cm Width: 20cm (teapot)

records.title: A COALPORT TEA BOWL AND SAUCER
records.description: circa 1800 The tea bowl duo with spiral shanked moulded body, each accented with gilded rim and floral sprig to the well. Diameter:14cm

records.title: A PARIS PORCELAIN VASE AND THREE TEACUP TRIOS
records.description: Comprising a 19th century Vieux Paris porcelain vase in the Rococo revival taste with enameled botanical reserves to both sides and gilt accents, together with a pair of Royal Albert pattern 6899 teacup trios and an Aynsley pattern A4086 teacup trio, each pieces stamped and with pattern number to the underside. Height: 28cm Width: 21.5cm (vase)

records.title: A GILT-METAL MOUNTED & PAINTED SEVRES PORCELAIN COVERED URN
records.description: late 19th Century The covered pedestal urn of compressed circular form in underglaze cobalt blue, the domed cover hand painted with two richly gilded reserves of a courting couple (signed lower right) and lakeside chateau landscape, opening to a white interior painted with a floral bouquet, the base and foot paste gilded with scrolls, finely gilt-metal mounted with scroll pierced rim, twin handles, beaded borders and capped with a tiered finial with a pierced starburst collar, upon a bronze square base with cut corners, marked under cover with 1848 Louis Philippe Sevres, Chateau des Tuileries and SV 46 stamps. Height: 24cm Width: 19cm

records.title: A REGENCY CHAMBERLAIN WORCESTER BOWL
records.description: circa 1820s Lavishly gilded with neoclassical forms, the square dessert or soup bowl with cusped corners centred with a roundel enclosing an allegorical semi-nude female figure reclining in a garden landscape, unmarked, with vintage Wm. H. Plummer & Co. of New York City Label. Height: 5cm Width: 23cm

records.title: A BROWN-WESTHEAD, MOORE & CO BONE CHINA DESSERT SET
records.description: Attrib. Brown-Westhead, Moore & Co (1862-1904), pattern B/1710, late 19th century The fine set comprising 8 dessert plates and 3 short comports, each decorated with central star, circlet of roses and surrounded by a pale green border with white and gilt lined feathered edge, the undersides with Alfred B. Pearce retailer stamp and inscribed with pattern number. Height: 5.5cm Width: 23.5cm

records.title: A FRENCH BELLE EPOQUE CREIL-MONTEREAU FAIENCE CABINET CHARGER
records.description: Barluet & Cie, Montereau, circa 1876-1895 Of shallow circular form, the central reserve finely hand-painted with a romantic pastoral scene depicting a courting young couple in an open garden landscape beside a stone fountain, surrounded by a wide bleu celeste border, enriched with four cartouches of winged putti in celestial clouds framed by intricate gilt scrolling foliage and trailing floral borders, the underside with impressed B&Cie Montereau impressed mark. Height: 4cm Width: 31cm

records.title: AN ANTIQUE BELLEEK JARDINIERE
records.description: Belleek, printed second black mark, period 1891-1926 The upper collar heavily encrusted with a continuous frieze of finely layered roses, marigolds, serrated foliage and hanging stems, above a tapering panel-ribbed lower body with a footed rim base, and covered in Belleek's signature nacreous glaze, with second black mark to the underside. Height: 17cm Width: 24cm

records.title: A ROYAL WORCESTER FLATBACK JUG
records.description: pattern 1094, 1888 The globular jug with a ribbed gilded handle with foliate mounts, decorated with floral sprays of in muted pastel tones with subtle gilt highlights upon an ivory ground; with puce backstamp and registration number underside. Height: 18cm Width: 15cmm

records.title: AN ART DECO CROWN DUCAL 'PATCH' PATTERN WALL CHARGER
records.description: Des. Charlotte Rhead for Crown Ducal, circa 1930s Decorated with three fan-shaped geometric sections outlined with raised stitches to resemble fabric panels and framed by a teal border with matching stitched design, stamped with 'Crown Ducal Made in England' mark to the reverse. Height: 4.5cm Width: 36cm (green plate)

records.title: A GROUP OF TWELVE WEDGWOOD 'CHARNWOOD' PATTERN PLATES
records.description: The bone china set comprising 6 entr?e or dessert plates and 6 side plates, all decorated in 'Charnwood' pattern and stamped Underside. Diameter: 20.5cm (larger plate)

records.title: A GROUP OF ROYAL DOULTON 'BUNNYKINS' CROCKERY
records.description: Des. Barbara Vernon, 20th century With transfer-printed classic 'Bunnykins' imagery, including a bowl and a saucer with pre-1954s marks, an Australiana Bunnykins bowl and others. Diameter: 20.5cm

records.title: A ROYAL WORCESTER PORCELAIN CLUSTER VASE
records.description: circa 1880s The cluster of four bud vases, each of bulbous amphora form with twin handles, painted with berries and blossoms upon a yellow ground and with parcel-gilt borders, stamped to the underside. Height: 15cm Width: 17cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT MINIATURE VASE AND A PAIR OF GAME TERRINES
records.description: Comprising a c1970s Walter Moorcroft M55 shape miniature vase tube-line decorated in 'Columbine' pattern, unmarked with its original adhesive foil label, together with a miniature pair of c1950s Noritake ceramic trompe l'oeil quail terrines in the French Pillivuyt manner, each stamped to the underside. Height: 7cm Width: 8 Cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT 'WISTERIA' SUGAR BOWL
records.description: c1928-1949 The sugar bowl and cover in 'Wisteria plum' pattern with blue ground, the underside with Royal Warrant paper label 'Potter to HM The Queen'. Height: 9cm Width: 11cm

records.title: TWO MOORCROFT 'POMEGRANATE' PATTERN SAUCERS
records.description: c1928-1949 The pair of shallow dishes / saucers decorated in 'Pomegranate' pattern, one with ochre-blue ground and flash signature, the other with classic cobalt blue ground, the underside with impressed facsimile signature and 'Potter to HM Queen'. Diameter:10.5cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT 'POMEGRANATE' PATTERN VASE
records.description: c1928-1949 The vase decorated in 'Pomegranate' pattern with ochre-blue ground, the underside with flash signature and impressed Marks. Height: 11cm Width: 14cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT NUMBERED EDITION 'CAROUSEL' PATTERN VASE
records.description: Designed by Rachel Bishop, c1996 The 32/5 shape vase designed for the Moorcroft Centenary celebrations with tube-lined columbine, redcurrants, hellebore and passionflower upon a washed green ground, numbered 695, signed 'J. Moorcroft' and dated 11.9.97 in gold pencil, with impressed Moorcroft stamp and other ciphers to the underside, in its original box. Height: 11cm Width: 13cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT LIMITED EDITION 'STURT DESERT PEA' VASE
records.description: Designed by Emma Bossons, Australian Commission series, c1998 The 226/7 shape vase, designed in homage to the vibrant Australian Sturt's desert pea (Swainsona formosa), decorated with a border of tube-lined crisp flowers with bright red stalks and foliage against a graduated yellow to green ground, with impressed Moorcroft stamp, signed 'EBossons', painted marks and other ciphers to the underside, and numbered 134/500, in its original box. Height: 19.5cm Width: 8.5cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT LIMITED EDITION 'TASMANIAN BLUE GUM' PATTERN VASE
records.description: Designed by Sally Tuffin, c1995 The 393/7 shape vase made exclusively for Australian Collectors, decorated with tube-lined flowering gum nuts and gum leaves on a pale celadon to blue ground, with impressed Moorcroft stamp, painted marks and other ciphers, numbered 450 in an edition of 450, in its original Box. Height: 18.5cm Width: 10cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT LIMITED EDITION 'SULPHUR-CRESTED COCKATOO' PLATE
records.description: Designed by Rachel Bishop, Australian Commission series, 1995. The 783/10 shape plate, tube-line decorated with the first design in this series: an iconic sulphur-crested cockatoo on a gumtree branch, draped by red flowers and foliage, upon a graduated blue ground, with impressed Moorcroft stamp, painted marks and other ciphers, and numbered 229/350, in its original box. Diameter:26cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT 'PHOENIX' PATTERN VASE
records.description: Designed by Rachel Bishop, 1996 The 99/8 shape vase, tube-line decorated with a phoenix bird, with plumage flowing around its contours in blues and greens on a soft olive to pale orange ground, with impressed Moorcroft stamp, signed R. Bishop, dated 5.4.97 in gold pencil, and with painted marks and other ciphers to the underside, in its original box. Height: 21cm Width: 10cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT LIMITED EDITION 'DRYANDRA' VASE
records.description: Designed by Angela davenport, Australian Event Exclusive, 2001 The 869/6 shape vase, tube-line decorated with three large yellow dryandra blooms amongst foliage against a varying blue-green ground, signed underglaze and only available to purchase during Angela Davenport's visit to Australia, with impressed Moorcroft stamp, painted marks and other ciphers, and numbered 57/250, in its original box. Height: 16cm Width: 14cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT 'ROUGH HAWKS BEARD' VASE AND A 'ROSE' JUG
records.description: Comprising a 7/5 shape baluster vase decorated in the 'Rough Hawks Beard' pattern, together with a 'Rose' pattern jug (Des. Sally Tuffin, 1992) with MCC stamp, both with impressed Moorcroft stamp and other ciphers to the underside, with Moorcroft Boxes. Height: 14.5cm Width: 13.5cm

records.title: A MOORCROFT 'ILLYARIE' VASE AND PIN TRAY
records.description: Designed by Emma Bossons, 2001 The 226/7 shape vase made exclusively for Australia, decorated with tube-lined Illyarie gum tree yellow flowers and bright red operculum above a warm orange outback soil, upon a graduated blue ground, together with a matching pin tray (780/4), each with impressed Moorcroft stamp, dated 2000, painted marks and other ciphers to the underside, in their original boxes. Height: 20cm Width: 8.5cm

records.title: A LARGE MOORCROFT TRIAL 'STURT DESERT PEA' PATTERN VASE
records.description: Des. Emma Bossons, c1998 the 62/11 shape vase designed in homage to the vibrant Australian Sturt's desert pea (Swainsona formosa), decorated with a continuous border of tube-lined crisp flowers with bright red stalks and foliage against a graduated yellow to green ground, with impressed Moorcroft stamp, painted marks and other ciphers, marked Trial and dated 6.4.00 to the underside, in its original Box. Height: 28cm Width: 20cm

records.title: A HUMMEL 'SWAYING LULLABY' PLAQUE AND 'SWEET DREAMS' MUSICAL DISPLAY STAND

records.title: A HUMMEL-STEIFF 'LITTLE MAESTRO' LIMITED EDITION COLLECTOR'S SET

records.title: A HUMMEL 'LOOKING AROUND' CHILDREN'S BOWL, PLATE & CUP SET
records.description: Goebel, Germany, early 2000s The 3-piece porcelain set, each printed with Hummel's 'Looking Around' figurine, in its original circus tent display box with handle, in its original Box. Diameter: 19cm (largest plate)

records.title: A CASED HUMMEL 'DEARLY BELOVED' GIFT SET

records.title: A HUMMEL-STEIFF LIMITED EDITION 'FROSTY FRIENDS' COLLECTOR'S SET

records.title: TWO HUMMEL FIGURAL GROUPS

records.title: A HUMMEL SPECIAL EDITION 'SOAP BOX DERBY' FIGURAL GROUP
records.description: Goebel, Germany, 2002 The first issue in the 'Moments in Time Collection', (number 2121, Tmk-8, 2000-), with certificate, in its original Box. Height: 17cm Width: 25cm

records.title: THREE HUMMEL FIGURINES

records.title: TWO HEREND 'QUEEN VICTORIA' PATTERN PORCELAIN VASES

records.title: AN ASSORTED GROUP OF HEREND PORCELAIN ITEMS
